topic: BMCC Nursing plan identity and cross-institution credential safeguards

source_evidence.name: Nursing/Dual Degree with CUNY School of Professional Studies

source_evidence.type: current BMCC scholarship eligible program list

interpretation.confirmed: BMCC catalog lists two distinct Nursing AAS plan codes sharing CIP 51.3801; both appear on BMCC's current scholarship eligible list.
interpretation.unresolved: BMCC NPS-AAS catalog displays NYSED 40117; BMCC registered-program inventory displays dual-degree 40090; archived SPS NBMC-BS displays 40117. Do not assume these are identical registrations.
interpretation.credential_guard: SPS BS belongs to SPS, not BMCC. Two BMCC plan codes do not imply two distinct award levels.
interpretation.admissions_guard: Neither scholarship eligibility nor catalog listing proves admission to the selective nursing program.
